content.content:
Relates to AuraDB or AuraDS instances

Usage:
  neo4j-cli aura instance [flags]
  neo4j-cli aura instance [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Creates a new instance
  delete      Deletes an instance
  deploy      Creates a new Aura instance and clones a local database into it
  get         Returns instance details
  list        Returns a list of instances
  load        Creates a new Aura instance pre-loaded with an example dataset
  overwrite   Starts the process of overwriting the specified instance with data from the source instance provided
  pause       Pauses an instance
  resume      Resumes an instance
  snapshot    Relates to an instance snapshots
  update      Updates an instance

Flags:
      --auth-url string          
      --base-url string          
  -c, --credential string        Name of a stored Aura credential to use for the command (see 'neo4j-cli credential aura-client list')
  -h, --help                     help for instance
      --organization-id string   ID of the Aura organization
      --project-id string        ID of the Aura project

Global Flags:
      --debug           Route Aura API activity (HTTP request/response wire, token acquisition, polling) to stderr; stdout is unaffected. Output may include the (best-effort-redacted) request/response bodies [env: NEO4J_DEBUG (set to 1 to enable)]
      --format string   Format to print console output in, from a choice of [default, json, table, toon]. (agents: prefer toon)
      --rw              Allow write operations. Auto-applied in interactive terminals; required when running under an agent harness or non-interactive script.

Use "neo4j-cli aura instance [command] --help" for more information about a command.
